escalationClass: V6 (last resort): one authenticated read this sandbox genuinely cannot perform
v1ToV5Exhausted: Repo and git-history searches done (no prior contact). The production store is unreachable from this sandbox (network policy plus no credential). No unauthenticated or public alternative exists, and none may be created.
doNot: return customer or prospect data beyond the fields below

correctionToTheNamedRoute.finding: Insufficient. src/leadgen-live-snapshot.mjs returns aggregate counts plus only the top 10 leads and top 10 accounts, and suppressed or already-contacted records are excluded from those results (src/lead-generation.mjs: suppressed candidates are skipped, status sent/replied/send-uncertain/suppressed is blocked). A clean response therefore cannot distinguish 'not present' from 'present but excluded or ranked below ten'. It reports suppressionRecords only as a count.

reads.method: authenticated read-only query of the production store collection `suppressions` (PostgresStore list; no HTTP route lists suppression contents, the dashboard summary exposes only a count)
reads.match: a row matches if value (lower-cased) equals hello@mypowerhouse.group, equals mypowerhouse.group, or the email ends with @<value> (server-core suppressionMatchesEmail); also apply send-safety suppressionLookup (value equals the email or the domain)
return: matched value and reason if any (e.g. one-click-unsubscribe, complaint, hard bounce, manual)

reads.method: GET https://uberbond-control-plane.onrender.com/api/prospects (owner/admin bearer; returns all prospect records, so filter client-side and return only the fields below)
reads.match: contact.email equals the email, or domain / website host equals mypowerhouse.group
return: previous contact timestamp if any (sentAt, previouslyContactedAt, priorContact.lastContactedAt)

reads.match: recipientEmail equals the email (reservations carry kind and status; status uncertain means an unreconciled effect; outbound events carry eventType and recipientEmail)
return: any reservation with status uncertain, dispatching or reserved yes/no

reads.match: reply `from` contains the email or domain, or prospectId belongs to a matching prospect; look at classification.label for bounce and complaint (unsubscribes are recorded in suppressions with reason one-click-unsubscribe, already covered by SUPPRESSIONS)
return: any bounce or complaint reply record yes/no

contactHistory.runtimeProspectAndOutboundSearched: true after PROSPECTS and OUTBOUND were read
contactHistory.hit: true if ANY match or ANY uncertain reservation

details: suppression match yes/no and matched value/reason

afterReturn: Apply returned contactHistory to the Powerhouse inputRecord in artifacts/outreach/prospect-tournament-20261002.json and rerun compileProspectVerification. Clean returns VERIFIED_CANDIDATE (projection tested); any hit rejects with a deterministic reason that must not be overridden, and replacement discovery resumes.
authority: None. Reading the ledgers authorizes no contact, send, wiring or merge.
